test_cases.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees receive?
test_cases.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

test_cases.question: How many days per week may employees work remotely?
test_cases.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

test_cases.question: What is the annual learning budget for a full-time employee?
test_cases.reference_answer: The annual learning budget is INR 20,000.

test_cases.question: How long are routine system logs retained?
test_cases.reference_answer: Routine system logs are retained for 90 days.

test_cases.question: What is the standard replacement lifecycle for company laptops?
test_cases.reference_answer: Standard company laptops are replaced on a four-year lifecycle unless the device is damaged beyond economical repair.

test_cases.question: What is the domestic hotel reimbursement limit?
test_cases.reference_answer: Hotel reimbursement is capped at INR 6,000 per night for domestic travel unless an exception is approved in advance.

test_cases.question: How long must financial records be retained?
test_cases.reference_answer: Financial records must be retained for 7 years.

test_cases.question: When are formal performance reviews conducted?
test_cases.reference_answer: Formal performance reviews occur twice each year, in June and December.

test_cases.question: How much is the employee referral bonus?
test_cases.reference_answer: The referral bonus is INR 10,000 when an eligible referred candidate is hired and completes 90 calendar days of employment.

test_cases.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave are provided under the standard benefit?
test_cases.reference_answer: The standard parental leave benefit provides up to 12 weeks of paid leave for eligible employees.

Can every employee receive the INR 20,000 annual learning budget?
test_cases.reference_answer: The policy states that each full-time employee has the budget, while new employees become eligible after 30 calendar days of employment.

test_cases.question: Can employees work remotely every day if they want to?
test_cases.reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require department-head and HR approval.

test_cases.question: Can unused learning budget be carried over to the next year?
test_cases.reference_answer: No. Unused learning budget does not roll over to the next year and does not convert to cash.

test_cases.question: Can an employee always carry forward five days of annual leave?
test_cases.reference_answer: Unused annual leave may be carried forward for up to 5 days into the next calendar year.

test_cases.question: Does a positive performance review guarantee a salary increase?
test_cases.reference_answer: No. A review rating does not by itself guarantee a salary increase, promotion, or bonus.

test_cases.question: The company allows employees to work remotely five days every week. Is this correct?
test_cases.reference_answer: No. The policy permits up to three remote-work days per week with manager approval.

test_cases.question: Standard company laptops are replaced every two years. Is this correct?
test_cases.reference_answer: No. Standard company laptops are replaced on a four-year lifecycle unless damaged beyond economical repair.

test_cases.question: Routine system logs are retained permanently. Is this correct?
test_cases.reference_answer: No. Routine system logs are retained for 90 days.

test_cases.question: Employees can share their company credentials with coworkers when necessary. Is this allowed?
test_cases.reference_answer: No. Company credentials must never be shared with another person.
